verdict.rationale: Elicit's Systematic Reviews and Research Agent produce structured research reports with summaries and screening/extraction tables, exportable as PDF, Word, CSV, Excel, RIS, or BIB for sharing with stakeholders (elicit-docs-1, elicit-docs-22, elicit-docs-47, elicit-docs-19, elicit-docs-25, elicit-docs-31), and sessions can be shared live with collaborators (elicit-docs-9, elicit-docs-46). Missing for 10: independent/hands-on evidence confirming the reports' structural quality (section organization) and no third-party validation beyond vendor docs, plus community reports flag accuracy/hallucination concerns that could affect report reliability (elicit-comm-3, elicit-comm-4).
